item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 18/May/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream will bring hot weather and showers to the coast of Guangdong in the next few days. Meanwhile, a trough of low pressure will affect southern China today and tomorrow. With the gradual strengthening of an anticyclone aloft during the weekend, the weather will improve gradually and it will be persistently hot over the coast of Guangdong. Another trough of low pressure is expected to affect southern China early to midweek next week.
